description: One person the agent can be asked for by name when emailing. Unlike Telegram and Slack, this list is an address book and not a fence: email reaches any address, so saving somebody here only means nobody has to type their address again.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: What the accountant will call this person when asking the agent to send something - for example 'Marwan' or 'The auditors'.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.description: The address that name stands for. The agent is never told it - it is only ever offered the name.

fields.label: Default
fields.description: Who an email goes to when the accountant does not say who to send it to.

name: Agent Email Destination
